description: Shared visual profile for campaign-facing Ashen Gauntlet maps. Uses semantic IDs only; exact Dungeondraft URIs remain in classification files.

jungleSurface.intent: Dark wet basalt under dense green growth; vegetation frames routes rather than filling every playable square.

ancientRuins.intent: Weathered pre-volcanic civic stone, ash-silted and physically older than dwarven or elven intrusions.

dwarven.intent: Rectilinear monumental engineering, heavy load-bearing forms, visible transport and mechanical purpose.

elven.intent: Curved pale ceremonial geometry integrated with water and living growth; precise rather than ruined-by-default.

burrows.intent: Asymmetrical creature-cut space with abrasion, roots, bones, and geology; avoid architectural right angles.

volcanicDeep.intent: Charcoal basalt and ash dominate; active lava is a high-contrast hazard/accent rather than a universal floor texture.

waterPolicy.assetUriStatus: No general river/lake surface URI exists in the current raw asset catalog; do not fabricate one.

transitionRules: Show at least two layers at major boundaries: geology plus the civilization/ecology intruding into it.
Use debris, roots, ash, water, rails, broken stairs, or wall geometry to communicate which layer cut through which.
Do not switch visual themes at a clean doorway unless the fiction specifically calls for an intact sealed complex.
Route families should be readable through material and geometry before labels or journal text are required.

lightingIntent.jungle: Diffuse canopy light with darker ravines and wet reflective pockets.
lightingIntent.dwarven: Low ambient light with warm industrial/fire accents when active systems survive.
lightingIntent.elven: Cool or pale magical accents with controlled pools of light and visible geometry.
lightingIntent.volcanic: Warm red-orange hazard glow against otherwise dark rock; avoid saturating the entire map.
